case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70210.text:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

sup:70240.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain fully flexible and look forward to building a great relationship together. Let us know if this works for you!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter

move.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH,

Thank you for your offer, which we have compared with the other offers we hold for this part.

German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 1863 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q3).

We are weighing several offers for this part; the options below would make yours the one we choose. A competing supplier has offered EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0).

We propose: EUR 27.00 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We would like to work with you and look forward to an offer we can compare favourably.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck

Option B: EUR 25.44 per unit, lead time 28 days, payment 45 days net.

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thanks for the nice words and the options! We hear you on the delivery record - we had some hiccups last year but we are working hard to fix them. We are happy to accept the 45 days payment you asked for.

Our offer is a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

Besides this, we can also offer a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days at standard terms. To give you a discount down to €31.00, we need to trade the lead time back to 52 days, as rushing it would just add costs.

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. Hallo, Option A with 30 days payment is better for us, so I can do €28.00 for that. We have free capacity for your parts.

move.body:
Dear Claudia Fuchsreiter,

Our overdue payments have understandably strained your confidence, and your concern about reliable payment is fair. Thank you for the substantial price reduction; we respect your limit on cost disclosure and note that the proposed lead time works for you.

We hold a competing offer at EUR 30.50 per unit (offer:70210-1).

We have raised our price offer modestly and ask for a further price concession in return. We are flexible on payment terms: Option A grants your requested payment term in exchange for the lower price, while Option B retains our standard terms—which works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 29.03 per unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days.
Option B: EUR 29.30 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days.

We appreciate your personal effort to make the HX shaft business work.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I looked at the competing offer you mentioned and I am willing to match the €30.50. 

We have to stick with Option A for the 30 days payment, as cash flow is important and we've had some late payments from you in the past. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. 

Let's agree on €30.50 with 30 days payment and 35 days lead time so we can get to work. Our offer is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
